stories.headline: Meta launches Muse, a personal AI assistant for everyone
stories.blurb: Meta is rolling out Muse, a new personal assistant aimed at bringing AI to mainstream users. The product is part of a multi-billion-dollar strategy to strengthen Meta's position in the AI race after falling behind competitors.
stories.why_it_matters: Meta is pivoting its AI strategy to focus on consumer accessibility rather than just developer tools.
stories.original_headline: Meta bets on AI agent Muse to catch up in AI race

stories.headline: Google just mapped every possible DNA mutation in the human genome
stories.blurb: DeepMind's AlphaGenome Atlas predicts how every single-letter DNA change affects the body — a reference map researchers can use to understand genetic diseases and design treatments without running thousands of lab experiments first.
stories.why_it_matters: Turns the entire human genome into queryable data instead of a research bottleneck.
stories.original_headline: Google’s Atlas of the human genome could pave the way for new treatments

stories.headline: Cognition just hit a $48B valuation — higher than Cursor before SpaceX bought it
stories.blurb: Cognition, the startup behind Devin (the AI coding agent), raised money at a $48 billion valuation — a higher multiple than Cursor commanded before its SpaceX acquisition. The deal signals investors still see room for multiple winners in AI coding tools, not just one dominant player.
stories.why_it_matters: The coding-tool market is heating up fast, and VCs are betting big on several horses at once.
stories.original_headline: Cognition hits $48B valuation, signaling investors believe AI coding is far from a winner-take-all market

stories.headline: Suno just replaced its entire AI music model with one trained on licensed tracks
stories.blurb: As copyright lawsuits stack up, Suno shipped v6—a new AI music generator trained exclusively on licensed music, abandoning the training data behind every previous version. The company's facing legal action from major labels over how it trained earlier models.
stories.why_it_matters: Building AI on unlicensed data is becoming legally untenable, even for products already in market.
stories.original_headline: Suno replaces its AI models with a new one trained on licensed music as copyright suits pile up
